minifat.methodH2: Prepare the FAT one step ahead
minifat.methodP1: MiniFAT lets you prepare the FAT dossier in advance, with a clear and professional structure. You compile it, generate it and send it to the manufacturer with all chapters already set up. They insert their documents directly behind yours, following the structure you defined.
minifat.methodP2: A few days before the FAT they send everything back complete: you can review it calmly, request additions and clarify any critical points. When you arrive on site, there is nothing left to wait for — everything is already ready.

faq.a: A FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) is the factory acceptance inspection: the verification that a machine or system meets agreed requirements before shipment to the client. MiniFAT helps you document it professionally.
Yes. MiniFAT generates the documentation and PDF directly on your device, so you can work on site without a connection. Cloud saving is optional.
Yes. MiniFAT supports IT, EN, DE and ES: cover page, index and document pages are generated in the chosen language.

faq.q: Is my data saved on my device?
faq.a: Yes. PDFs are generated locally and your data stays on the device. Nothing is sent to external servers.

faq.q: Can I edit an already created FAT?
faq.a: Yes. You can reopen a saved FAT, update data and documents, and regenerate the PDF at any time.
Yes. In addition to standard certificates, declarations and attachments, you can include custom documents in the dossier.
